title: Define claim_seq wrap semantics for floor at UINT32_MAX
description: Codereview finding (P3): lichen_slot_claim_seq_commit monotonic guard (entry->seq >= seq) plus the process_claim gate (claim_seq <= cached) mean a floor of 0xFFFFFFFF (hostile NV content or a gateway that genuinely burned max seq) permanently rejects all claims including wrapped seq 0, with no recovery short of NV wipe. Spec/08 GCP-6.5 does not define wrap. Options: spec amendment (declare wrap illegal / require new IID), or module-side recovery. Discovered from project-LICHEN-worker6-uiun 3x codereview.
